Favite.why: AOI inspection and metrology equipment maker moving from display into 2.5D/3D advanced packaging: die-location / overlay metrology and fine-line RDL inspection for wafer- and panel-level (FOPLP) packaging; its tools gain as AI-chip packaging capacity expands.
Favite.evidence: Favite 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026), letter to shareholders: R&D focused on 2.5D/3D advanced-packaging inspection and Die Location / Overlay / 3D metrology; its 12-inch wafer-level inspection system has been adopted by a flagship customer and die-location metrology is in verification with substrate and packaging customers.

players.product: AOI inspection and die-location / overlay metrology tools for wafer- and panel-level (FOPLP) 2.5D/3D advanced packaging and fine-line RDL

quarterly_data.signal: Letter to shareholders: 2025 consolidated revenue was about NT$4.59 hundred million, down about 31% from NT$6.67 hundred million in 2024, and the year closed with an operating loss as the display-panel industry cut capex and new semiconductor-inspection tools faced long verification cycles; December 2025 revenue rebounded nearly tenfold and the month was profitable on the company's own (unaudited) accounts.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue about NT$4.59 hundred million (-31% YoY; 2024: NT$6.67 hundred million)

quarterly_data.signal: Letter to shareholders: despite the loss, the 2025 R&D spending ratio rose, focused on 2.5D/3D advanced-packaging inspection: high-end AOI for 2μm fine-line RDL and metrology for Die Location, Overlay and 3D measurement, with AI applied to AOI and metrology. Its 12-inch wafer-level high-speed intelligent inspection system has been adopted by a flagship (unnamed) customer; die-location metrology for advanced packaging is in deep verification with well-known substrate and packaging customers and is expected to become a new revenue engine once it passes verification. In FOPLP (panel-level fan-out packaging) it leverages its large-glass-substrate (LCD/OLED) handling experience.
quarterly_data.figure: 2μm RDL inspection; sub-micron die-location metrology in customer verification

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor / advanced packaging / IC substrate tools listed in the annual report: wafer-level 2.5D advanced-packaging die-location metrology, wafer-level 3D IC die-location metrology, panel-level 2.5D advanced-packaging die-location metrology, wafer AI optical inspection, FOPLP multi-layer RDL fine-line defect inspection, TGV post-drilling inspection/metrology and inline chip-on-tray inspection.

2026 operating plan (letter to shareholders): management calls 2026 a 'value conversion year' and does not assume an overly optimistic market recovery; the priority is converting the high-end semiconductor and advanced-packaging inspection and metrology tools that entered customer verification in 2025 into orders and revenue, alongside aftermarket service and AI-module upgrades for its installed base.
